title: Learning to Decode Against Compositional Hallucination in Video Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of compositional hallucinations in Video Large Language Models, proposing a benchmark (OmniVCHall) and a mitigation framework (TriCD). While it discusses linguistic 'Yes-bias' and impact on content moderation, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
